title: 第8章 风闻司
content_zh:
魏乐府吐出了一口浊气，收了架势，浑身上下气血奔腾。

    他这时候终于是明白了吃饱后这具身体的强势了。

    鲸吞蚕食只要吃就行了，足够的养分搭配上老弟现在的重楼功元灵状态，他的实力二十四小时都在提升。

    而魏乐府要做的就很简单了，就是练宝塔桩和明堂劲就可以了。

    而有了足够的食物摄入，龙精虎猛更是让他练这两门武学时完全没有疲惫。

    可以说除了吃饭和睡觉，剩下的时间可以全用在修炼上。

    甚至今天他就只睡了五个小时就恢复了状态。

    不过魏乐府也不傻，作为穿越者自然是知道过犹不及，真要往死里压榨身体，有可能会猝死的。

    他估计，这种进度下，自己只需要一年时间就能够把这三门武学练到大成。

    这效率已经很快了，孟惟可是人到中年才大成的。

    丁守成冬练三伏夏练三九，至今也才小成。

    其实还能更快的，但却被丁守成的身体给拖累了。

    他长期没吃饱，连带着天赋都因为营养不够而沉寂了两个。

    真要是全盛状态的话，也就半年就够了。

    虽然这效率依旧比不上沈千钧，但也已经非常强势了。

    不过也正因为如此，魏乐府才越发认识到沈千钧的离谱程度。

    一大早就赶到了六扇门点卯，又是一顿吃到饱的早餐，歇了两分钟后就动身出去巡街。

    昨天有了陆翰墨的‘提点’，魏乐府自然是知道规矩了。

    和光同尘才是公门里的生存方式。

    巡了一圈后完成工作留痕，魏乐府就转道去了风闻司。

    “你是...昨儿个新来的那位丁捕快？”风闻司主事贺季同一眼就认出了魏乐府。

    “见过贺主事，是我。”魏乐府当即说道。

    他对这贺季同并不熟悉，六扇门里比较熟悉的就是田牧川，毕竟见过十几次面。

    其他人接触真不多，都是孟惟这位馆主去的。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu exhaled a breath of turbid air and lowered his posture, with blood rushing all over his body.

    At this time, he finally understood the power of this body after eating.

    All he needs to do is eat. With enough nutrients and my brother's current Chonglou Kung Yuanling state, his strength is improving around the clock.

    What Wei Yuefu has to do is very simple, just practice Pagoda Zhuang and Mingtang Jin.

    And with enough food intake, the dragon spirit and tiger ferocity made him not tired at all when practicing these two martial arts.

    It can be said that apart from eating and sleeping, the rest of the time can be spent on cultivation.

    Even today he only slept for five hours before recovering.

    However, Wei Yuefu is not stupid. As a time traveler, he naturally knows that going too far is not enough. If he really wants to squeeze his body to death, he may die suddenly.

    He estimated that at this pace, it would only take him one year to master these three martial arts.

    This efficiency is already very fast, and Meng Wei did not achieve success until he was middle-aged.

    Ding Shoucheng practiced Sanfu in the winter and Sanjiu in the summer, and has only achieved some success so far.

    In fact, it could be faster, but it was hindered by Ding Shoucheng's body.

    He hadn't eaten enough for a long time, and even his talent had been dormant for two years due to lack of nutrition.

    If it were really in full swing, half a year would be enough.

    Although this efficiency is still not as good as Shen Qianjun, it is already very strong.

    But precisely because of this, Wei Yuefu became more and more aware of how outrageous Shen Qianjun was.

    I arrived at Liumen Dianmao early in the morning and had another all-you-can-eat breakfast. After resting for two minutes, I set off to patrol the streets.

    With Lu Hanmo's 'tips' yesterday, Wei Yuefu naturally knew the rules.

    Being in harmony with light and dust is the way of life in Gongmen.

    After completing the patrol and leaving traces, Wei Yuefu transferred to the Rumor Department.

    "Are you... the new agent Ding who arrived yesterday?" He Jitong, the head of the Rumor Department, recognized Wei Yuefu at a glance.

    "I've seen Mr. He, it's me." Wei Yuefu said immediately.

    He was not familiar with He Jitong. The one he was more familiar with among the six doors was Tian Muchuan. After all, he had met him more than a dozen times.

    I don’t really have much contact with other people, except Meng Wei, the owner of the museum.
